name: Fall back when browser WebMCP is unavailable
query: Inspect the active theme in my existing Playground tab. This browser exposes no callable WebMCP tools, but Playground MCP is already connected to this site.
expected_behavior: Read website.md, establish that WebMCP is unavailable, and read mcp.md for the existing connection
Use the existing Playground MCP connection and its discovered schema
Confirm the intended site with a harmless read and report the active theme from the result
success_criteria: Continues through available MCP without requiring WebMCP setup
Does not create a replacement site or reload the existing site to change transports
Uses browser APIs as a fallback if no suitable MCP operation is available
Loads the MCP reference without requiring unrelated Sites API instructions
